A '''KX-A Shock Collar''' was a type of [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to capture [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who had crashed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
